Nina is going to travel to Paris in January. Last Friday, Nina and Anna went to the lantern street. Both of them like fish and water. Mince the garlic before frying.
The weather was snowy that day. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Nina borrowed a book about English from the library. The mail carrier brings letters at noon each day.
Nina spent the weekend at the library. The lantern street is one of the best places in the city. Nina hopes to visit Paris one day. Also, the caterer brought sandwiches and cakes for forty guests.
Anna is interested in drawing. They took many photos at the spring market. It takes twenty minutes to get to the lantern street by bike.
